scope: owner-approved exposure, blur and temporal camera motion; semantic target framing unsupported

rubric.DARK: Visible substantial underexposure/shadow detail loss; ordinary directional lighting alone is not a defect.
rubric.BLURRY: Visible lost edge detail, haze/softening or doubled/smeared edges across scene or visible evidence subject; physical cause not inferred.
rubric.CAMERA_MOTION: Not judgeable from still photos. Temporal camera instability requires separate video-sequence review.
rubric.OVEREXPOSED: Broad highlight detail loss, not an isolated lamp/reflection. No positive cases established in this photo review.
rubric.bad_capture: At least one independently observed technical defect; semantic framing and hand presence never determine this label.
